text: 印度财政部税收局发布第20/2026-Customs(ADD)号通报称，接受印度商工部于2026年5月7日对原产于或进口自中国和韩国的邻苯二甲酸酐作出的第一次反倾销日落复审肯定性终裁建议，决定继续征收为期5年的反倾销税，分别为中国40.08美元/吨、韩国140.17美元/吨。涉案产品的印度海关编码为29173500。措施自本通报发布于官方公报之日起生效。
text_en: India's Ministry of Finance, Department of Revenue, issued Notification No. 20/2026-Customs (ADD), stating it accepted the affirmative final findings of the first anti-dumping sunset review on phthalic anhydride originating in or imported from China and South Korea, recommended by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on May 7, 2026, and decided to continue levying anti-dumping duties for five years, at USD 40.08 per ton for China and USD 140.17 per ton for South Korea. The Indian customs code for the subject goods is 29173500. The measures take effect from the date of publication of this notification in the Official Gazette.
